notes: Your characters stay themselves when you send a photo. Until now a photo in the conversation handed the entire reply to a vision model — so a 7B image reader was writing the character's lines instead of the model that writes every other message, and it brought its own refusal training with it. Send something intimate and the answer could be a polite offer to swap recipes. The vision model now only reads: it turns the photo into a description, and the character's reply is written from that description by the usual text model, in the usual voice. This also means an explicit photo is never uploaded to a hosted provider — only the reading travels, and it goes to the model that has been handling this conversation all along.
